omissions: Atlas/base stage is an explicitly simplified reconstruction: procedural blocks and a ground only.
Sky gradient, fog, particles, contact-shadow decals and visual event effects are not exported.
Narration, captions, montage and transitions remain in the original Remotion project.
Camera cue timing is estimated because inline aligned words are absent.
guide: additional equipment panels from the Three.js renderer are omitted; base rig accessories are retained.
Example explicitly reduces procedural detailBudget to 6; the original Riis project is unchanged.
Riis environment v1 replaces 19 named legacy stage meshes, recorded in environment.replacedMeshIds; actors, props and camera unchanged.
Artistic reconstruction: architecture, terrain, palette and lighting are invented visual design, not documented canonical Riis geography. No external assets.
Depth haze uses tinted distant geometry; cinematic additionally uses a bounded homogeneous volume. No weather simulation or canonical city map.
